about_the_game:
Rhythia is a game in which you aim and hit musical beats with precision. You will be targeting blocks, mastering timing, building combos, perfecting your accuracy and climbing leaderboards. In the beginning you will find yourself learning the 3x3 grid layout, aiming at individual blocks and building basic combos by hand, but in short time you can become a rhythm master, with flawless accuracy, perfect timing and seamless aim transitions, all for those satisfying perfect scores. This intense focus on precision and timing rewards dedicated practice, so you will need to develop your aim and musical reflexes to achieve mastery.

Join forces with other players in competitive Leaderboards, compare scores globally, collaborate and compete with rhythm gamers from around the world. Add custom maps to increase your enjoyment, from simple practice maps to complete song overhauls, Rhythia's

Community Support has allowed content creators from around the world to design interesting and innovative beatmaps. While the core gameplay is in the form of the standard aim-based rhythm experience, there are a range of interesting challenges in the form of Different Camera Modes.

If you don't find any songs or difficulty levels you enjoy, you can explore the growing library with the Online Hub, browse scores, track statistics, and view leaderboards in any way you like, and even monitor your improvement to make for engaging progression.

short_description: Rhythia is a game about aiming and hitting musical beats with precision timing, within a dynamic 3x3 grid system. Use your reflexes to target flying blocks, combine accurate aim with perfect rhythm, and finally master the leaderboards against players who challenge your precision skills.
